reader_flags.reason: Explicit_absence: intact named ligament groups and menisci, no deep femorotibial cartilage defects or Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: final small full-thickness patellar focus lacks regional measurement despite mostly superficial PF findings in body; focal patellar marrow edema lacks impact cause and acute fracture-line assessment. Effusion and synovitis unmentioned. The final focal exception prevents filling PF negative from the broader body description.

Direct synovitis supports positive. Below_threshold: ACL mucoid degeneration and final MCL grade-I sprain. Explicit_absence: normal lateral meniscus. Missing_evidence: medial bare gradeIII/extrusion lacks definite tear/surface evidence; medial thinning lacks depth/extent; widespread fluid states distribution without clear moderate/large amount; Baker cyst numeric-only size lacks severity grade; subarticular fracture with edema lacks acute timing and does not separately establish contusion. Lateral/PF cartilage unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact cruciates, normal menisci/cartilage, no bone edema. Below_threshold: slightly increased fluid with minimal recess distension. Missing_evidence: laterale banden may mean lateral-side ligaments rather than clearly both collateral groups, so MCL anatomy is unresolved; no edema alone does not exclude an acute cortical fracture line. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and no fracture/Baker cyst. Below_threshold: lateral meniscal internal degeneration without tear and tiny fluid. Missing_evidence: medial maceration is abnormal morphology but accompanies explicit no obvious tear and final no significant tear, leaving current tear interpretation contradictory; cartilage OA/severe thinning lacks qualifying region extent and exact depth; focal subchondral edema is not directly traumatic. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: normal cruciates/collaterals/lateral meniscus and femorotibial/trochlear cartilage. Below_threshold: central medial meniscal signal without surface-tear criteria, no significant fluid/pathological popliteal cyst. Missing_evidence: fine partial patellar ulcer and unnamed final grade2 lack unambiguous depth/extent; fine may describe width rather than superficial depth. Peripheral marrow edema/subcortical fracture lacks acute timing or separate impact-contusion diagnosis. Bipartite patellar variant is not automatically an acute fracture. Synovitis unmentioned; preserve source ending fragment and probable typographical rotura in impression.

Direct surfacing medial horizontal tear and definite lateral radial tear support positives; only additional lateral horizontal component is suspected. Below_threshold: slight suprapatellar distension. Missing_evidence: complete ACL rupture is suspected rather than definite; bare early femorotibial grade2 lacks mapped depth/extent. MCL/PF cartilage/synovitis/Baker/bone injury unmentioned. Paramensical cysts are not Baker cysts.

Explicit_absence: normal continuous ACL/MCL, no significant fluid, no formed Baker cyst and normal bone morphology/signal. Missing_evidence: report repeatedly names lateral meniscus with both a definite body/anterior/root tear and body/posterior degeneration without rupture; preserve overlapping-body contradiction, do not silently rename a mention to medial. Bare grade-I lateral/PF cartilage findings lack explicit preserved thickness/depth. Medial meniscus/medial cartilage/synovitis unmentioned. Small characteristic-bursa fluid remains below Baker threshold.

Direct medial meniscal tear and moderate fluid support positives. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: mucoid ACL without tear; normal lateral meniscus, collaterals and femorotibial cartilage; PF focal softening explicitly without erosion. Missing_evidence: possibly stress-related marrow edema/cysts do not establish impact contusion or acute fracture status. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned; parameniscal cyst distinct.

Direct horizontal/flap medial meniscal tear and moderate effusion support positives. Explicit_absence: unremarkable ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus. Below_threshold: tiny Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: moderate medial thinning and mild lateral/PF OA lack depth/extent; reactive subchondral marrow changes are not directly traumatic and do not assess acute line. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct chronic synovitis positive. Medial OA positive uses diffuse high-grade chondrosis of the weightbearing femoral condyle as qualitative depth/extent evidence; flag region-size inference. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL/both menisci. Missing_evidence: diffuse lateral cartilage damage lacks depth; popliteal cyst numeric-only partly corrupted dimensions lack moderate/large grade; subchondral edema does not establish impact or acute fracture. PF synovitis location is not PF cartilage assessment. No actual knee-fluid amount is reported apart from tendon-associated fluid; effusion remains unmentioned. Differential inflammatory/infectious causes do not change target-specific certainty.

Explicit_absence: normal ligaments/menisci and no Baker cyst. Below_threshold: mild fluid. Missing_evidence: incipient OA lacks explicit cartilage depth/extent in all compartments; generic Normal conclusion does not erase detailed body findings. Synovitis and bone injury unmentioned.

Direct medial meniscal tears and moderate fluid support positives. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, intact femorotibial cartilage and no acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: minimal Baker cyst despite rupture. Missing_evidence: mild patellar fissuring lacks explicit superficial depth or qualifying extent; do not infer depth from mild alone. Reactive marrow change and benign enchondroma do not override direct injury exclusions. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct complex medial meniscal tear and mild synovitis support positives. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL and lateral/trochlear cartilage. Below_threshold: mild effusion and small leaking popliteal cyst. Missing_evidence: lateral marginal fraying is not a direct tear; medial and diffusely distributed patellar mixed partial/full ulcers do not establish extent of the deeper regions; final unnamed grades2/3 do not resolve this. Reactive marrow edema/remodeling does not establish impact contusion or acute line.

Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL/menisci/cartilage and no effusion. All three compartments have normal marrow signal, supporting contusion negative; whole report quote preserves that scope. Missing_evidence: normal signal alone does not explicitly exclude cortical acute fracture. Postoperative pes ganglion-resection tract edema/5x8-mm fluid is not Baker cyst or synovitis. Both remain unmentioned; no clinical state was derived from the postoperative status.

Explicit_absence: intact ligaments/menisci and otherwise normal lateral/PF cartilage. Below_threshold: small effusion. Missing_evidence: known 11x15-mm osteochondral lesion with cartilage fissure and fluid around nondisplaced osseous fragment does not specify how much cartilage thickness/area is lost; lesion size is not automatically a cartilage-loss measure. Adjacent edema/cysts lack impact cause; known lesion lacks current acute cortical/line diagnosis. Small plica does not establish synovitis. Baker/synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact ligaments/menisci, preserved femorotibial/trochlear cartilage and normal marrow signal for contusion. Below_threshold: explicit mild patellar surface fraying controls over the generic moderate-chondrosis label; no significant effusion/Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: normal signal alone does not exclude acute cortical fracture. Hoffa edema is distinct from synovitis, which remains unmentioned.

Named contusion with marrow edema after hyperextension trauma supports positive; possible linear elements/non-displaced fracture remain equivocal, not a definite acute fracture. Flag exact Dutch uncertainty scope and corrupted element en spacing. Explicit_absence: normal menisci. Below_threshold: minimal recess fluid. Missing_evidence: at-least-partial ACL tear lacks high-grade fraction; laterale banden does not clearly establish medial collateral integrity. Gastrocnemius insertion injury/hemorrhage is not MCL or Baker evidence. Cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; 2-cm measure is marrow edema.

Direct surfacing lateral horizontal tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/medial meniscus, no increased joint fluid and normal bone signal for contusion. Missing_evidence: normal signal does not explicitly exclude acute cortical line. Retinacular grade-II sprain does not affect MCL. Popliteus tenosynovitis is not joint-lining synovitis; cartilage/synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: ACL bundle degeneration without disruption, preserved MCL, no medial meniscal pathology, lateral degeneration/pseudoextrusion without a described tear, small joint fluid and small Baker-bursa fluid without formed cyst. Missing_evidence: bare cartilage grades and thinning/fissures/small unmeasured erosions lack depth/extent; atypical plateau contour/sclerosis is only possibly post-old-fracture, without a settled current acute-line or impact-edema assessment. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct medial meniscal tear and large effusion support positives. Explicit_absence: normal lateral meniscus/cartilage. Missing_evidence: bare ACL/MCL tears lack complete/high-grade fraction (and acute MCL-associated edema); Segond avulsion/subchondral fracture with massive edema lacks explicit acute timing; fracture-associated nonspecific marrow edema does not independently establish contusion. No blanket fracture-subtype exclusion is applied. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: degenerative ACL without disruption, normal collateral appearance, isolated medial meniscal degeneration and normal remaining bone morphology/signal. Missing_evidence: possible old lateral horizontal tear leaves current tear unresolved; cartilage thinning/unnamed gradesI/II lack depth/extent; mild Baker-bursa inflammation does not state the collection amount, so do not equate inflammation severity with cyst volume. Joint effusion and joint synovitis are not mentioned; tendon/bursal inflammation is distinct.

Explicit_absence: normal menisci/cruciates/collaterals, no cartilage pathology/fluid and normal remaining marrow signal for contusion (no focal marrow exception is reported). Missing_evidence: marrow signal alone does not exclude acute cortical fracture. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: preserved MCL, no meniscal tears, no osteochondral lesion (used as broad articular-surface exclusion) and preserved PF surface, no fracture/bone contusion. Below_threshold: minimal fluid. Missing_evidence: distal posterolateral ACL intrasubstance tear lacks overall high-grade fiber fraction despite normal orientation. PCL probable sprain does not establish ACL grade. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned; flag broad osteochondral-exclusion scope for review.

Direct medial meniscal tear and moderate joint fluid support positives. Explicit_absence: normal cruciates/collaterals/lateral meniscus and normal marrow signal for contusion. Missing_evidence: medial mild OA/erosion lacks depth/extent; PF named ICRSIII establishes deep fissure but its 1-mm thickness is not the length/area of the cartilage-loss region. The moderate adjective qualifies joint fluid, not the numeric-only 6-cm communicating Baker cyst. Normal marrow signal does not exclude acute cortical line. Lateral cartilage and synovitis unmentioned; synovial cyst does not mean synovitis.

Direct complex/radial/root medial meniscal tear, moderate effusion and large Baker cyst support positives. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus. Missing_evidence: full-thickness cartilage abnormalities lack qualifying region extent in all compartments; 2 weeks of pain does not explicitly date the insufficiency fracture, and marrow edema is not an independent impact-contusion diagnosis. The insufficiency subtype is not categorically excluded; acute timing remains unestablished. Synovitis unmentioned; 0.9-cm bodies are not cartilage-loss measurements.

Definite medial root/complex and surfacing lateral oblique tears support positives. Explicit_absence: intact ACL/MCL. Below_threshold: small fluid. Missing_evidence: medial/lateral thinning/fissures lack depth/extent; full-depth apex-to-medial-facet loss plus a small lateral focus does not specify extent of high-grade loss, while remainder thinning has unknown depth. Qualified no suspicious focal marrow signal is not an unqualified contusion/acute-fracture exclusion. Tendon-sheath fluid is not Baker cyst; synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Subtotal ACL rupture with only isolated remaining fibers explicitly supports high-grade positive; direct contusional marrow edema supports contusion positive. Explicit_absence: intact MCL/menisci/cartilage. Below_threshold: small hemarthrosis. Missing_evidence: contusion description does not explicitly assess a separate discrete acute fracture line. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned.

Explicit_absence: intact ACL, normal collaterals/lateral meniscus/cartilage/bone morphology and signal, no effusion. Below_threshold: small Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: medial horizontal signal reaches surface on explicitly one slice only, with final partial injury grade2b rather than a definite tear diagnosis. Retain uncertain rather than overriding the stated insufficient image-count evidence or treating grade2b as pure internal degeneration. Patellar-tendon inflammation is not joint synovitis; synovitis unmentioned.

Direct complete ACL tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: unremarkable MCL/menisci and no popliteal cyst. Below_threshold: small fluid. Missing_evidence: medial superficial fibrillation coexists with unquantified mild thinning; no full-thickness loss does not exclude greater-than-half partial loss. PF thinning/partial fissure likewise lacks depth/extent. Lateral cartilage/synovitis/bone injury unmentioned.

Direct patellar/lateral femoral contusions and moderate-to-severe lipohemarthrosis support positives. Fracture positive uses the discrete displaced linear ossific fragment with patellar donor site and associated contusion plus current lipohemarthrosis: acute injury-context inference, flagged because comparison CT is undated. It is not inferred from lipohemarthrosis alone. Explicit_absence: normal cruciates/collaterals/menisci and medial/lateral cartilage. Missing_evidence: numeric-only uncomplicated popliteal cyst lacks severity grade. PF paragraph names cartilage in a compartment heading but supplies bone/retinacular findings without assessing PF cartilage loss; PF OA remains unmentioned, as does synovitis.

Moderate effusion positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/menisci, no Baker cyst/acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: MCL grade-I sprain. Missing_evidence: high-grade medial and full-depth PF loss lack region extent; lateral partial fissuring lacks precise depth/extent. Degenerative marrow edema does not override direct injury exclusions. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct complete ACL rupture, bucket-handle medial meniscal tear and moderate fluid support positives. Contusion positive uses marrow edema explicitly attributed to pivot-shift injury (impact mechanism); flag source-level inference. Below_threshold: mild MCL distension without rupture. Explicit_absence: no Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: marrow-injury description does not explicitly assess a discrete acute fracture line. Lateral meniscus/cartilage/synovitis unmentioned; popliteus bursitis does not imply synovitis.

Direct complex medial meniscal tear supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL/MCL/lateral meniscus, no lateral/PF defects and no acute fracture/bone bruise. Below_threshold: small fluid and Baker cyst. Missing_evidence: medial high-grade loss lacks regional extent. Reactive joint-line edema does not override normal MCL or bone-injury exclusions. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct complex/flap medial meniscal tear and extensive effusion support positives. Explicit_absence: no lateral meniscal degeneration/tear. Below_threshold: small popliteal cyst. Missing_evidence: distal ACL partial tear/distension lacks high-grade fraction; ungraded MCL distension lacks high-grade fiber/acute edema assessment; femorotibial mild thinning with bare gradeII lacks depth/extent; fully depleted patellar ridge cartilage lacks measured or broad qualifying regional extent, with other bare grades insufficient. Patellar edema/cysts lack impact cause/acute line assessment; normal tibial/femoral signal does not cover patellar marrow. Synovitis unmentioned.

Explicit_absence/below_threshold: ACL myxoid degeneration, final grade-I MCL sprain, medial grade-II internal degeneration and normal lateral meniscus. Missing_evidence: subchondral osteochondral defects have numeric lesion sizes but do not explicitly state corresponding cartilage thickness/area lost; do not equate osseous component size to cartilage-loss region. Subarticular fracture/microfracture with edema lacks acute timing and separate impact-contusion evidence. Lateral cartilage/effusion/synovitis/Baker unmentioned; subcutaneous reticular fluid is not joint effusion.

Direct complex/radial medial meniscal tear and moderate fluid support positives. Below_threshold: grade-I MCL sprain. Explicit_absence: well-maintained lateral cartilage. Missing_evidence: grossly intact ACL/lateral meniscus is qualified and retained uncertain; diffuse unnamed medial grades2/3 and minor focal PF damage lack mapped depth/extent; leaking numeric-only 5-cm Baker cyst lacks grade. Definite subarticular fracture line and edema with insufficiency-type conclusion lack explicit acute timing; no subtype-wide exclusion is imposed. Fracture-related edema is not a separate contusion diagnosis. Synovitis unmentioned.

Direct surfacing lateral meniscal tear supports positive despite additional radial fraying. Explicit_absence/below_threshold: intact ACL/MCL/medial meniscus, maintained cartilage with only minor lateral fibrillation, small fluid. Missing_evidence: initially possible PVNS nodule followed by recall where focus is not readily appreciated and no blooming suggests no PVNS, but does not conclusively establish/exclude all synovial inflammation; preserve uncertain synovitis and full temporal context. Qualified no sinister marrow change does not exclude contusion/acute cortical line. Baker unmentioned. The report incorporates a recall examination; do not infer nodule size as cartilage loss.

Explicit_absence: preserved cruciates/collaterals, no meniscal ruptures and normal remaining bone morphology/signal. Below_threshold: medial meniscal degeneration and no significant effusion. Missing_evidence: tibial unnamed gradeII and patellar gradeIII lack mapped depth/extent; bilateral tibial cartilage statement applies both femorotibial compartments. Synovitis/Baker unmentioned; insertional enthesitis is not synovitis.

Direct joint synovitis interpretation supports positive. Explicit_absence: normal ACL. Below_threshold: both meniscal grade-II degeneration without surfacing tear; medial extrusion alone does not establish a tear. Missing_evidence: MCL gradeI-II with periligament edema spans injury grades and lacks high-grade fiber fraction; medial thinning and PF loss of cartilage integrity/unnamed gradeIV lack qualifying regional extent; fluid and numeric-only 55x18-mm Baker cyst lack severity grades; subchondral edema lacks impact cause/acute line assessment. Lateral cartilage unmentioned.

notes: Personally read all 50 original gold-blinded reports in five groups of ten and reasoned all 600 targets under frozen rubric. No other 064 annotations, gold, legacy/external labels, regex/NLI labeling or default filling accessed/used. Python only assembled explicit personal choices and validated exact contiguous original-language quotes, schema and UID coverage through rsna.labels.read_reviews. Unfinished work stayed outside initiative. Explicit absence and below-threshold findings distinguished in notes; missing severity/extent/acuity/anatomy and contradictions masked. Only completion/coverage/hashes shared with root; flags withheld pending independent source-first review. Draft does not confer training eligibility or image diagnostic accuracy.
